title: 1x Mini Plug Peperomia Orba ‘Pixie Lime’ – Semi-Succulent Houseplant, Easy Care
description:
1x Mini Plug Peperomia Orba ‘Pixie Lime’ (Teardrop Peperomia)
 
 A charming
 
  compact semi-succulent houseplant
 
 with small, rounded, lime-green leaves and a neat, mounding habit.
 
  Peperomia orba
 
 is perfect for desks, shelves, or windowsills, adding a fresh pop of greenery to any indoor space. Easy to care for and slow-growing, it’s ideal for beginners and plant lovers alike.Native to
 
  Central and South America
 
 , this perennial thrives in bright, indirect light and warm indoor conditions. Its low-maintenance nature makes it a great choice for busy households or offices.
